title: Vents.
officialText:
The discharge stacks, vents and outlet parts of all pressure-relieving and pressure-limiting devices shall be located so
that gas is safely discharged to the outdoors. Discharge stacks and vents shall be designed to prevent the entry of water, insects and
other foreign material that could cause blockage. The discharge stack or vent line shall be at least the same size as the outlet of the
pressure-relieving device.
